task: M1.I1 art integration review: existing game preservation checks
sourceState: Uncommitted review additions were present. This report identifies the unchanged gameplay payload by SHA-256; it is not a claim that the new review deliverable was committed or deployed.

environment.build: Existing dist prepared by the parent task; the five gameplay files below matched source, dist and served bytes.
environment.context: Fresh browser.newContext; no persistent profile and no connection to a real browser session.
environment.storage: Synthetic new-story storage confined to isolated context; browser closed after checks. No user browser storage was read or modified.

coverage: Both loan branches, 25-gallon gift and repeated loan decision
Rescue idempotence, four surviving groups and starter compatibility
Deterministic ecosystem care and breeding conditions
Critter framing, interest and exactly-once revenue
Save round-trip with full object equality and corrupt-primary backup recovery using synthetic storage
Unblocked nearby interaction samples and scene-exit positions
Existing continuous movement collision, normalized diagonal speed and running

reportedCheckpoints: Girl Hero and opposite-gender rival can be named.
Opening completes, animals survive, 25-gallon gift and $100 loan arrive.
All four groups found by walking through bedroom, house, and yard.
Professor Nugget gives notebook and the $15 search reward.
Critz shop is enterable; purchases debit money and the free kit is claimable.
Vet, Drug Store, Bike Shop, and Glow n’ Blow open; medicine, skateboard, and hide purchases work.
Both neighboring homes and character dialogue are reachable.
Management changes live conditions, inventory, and stats.
Framed tank photo posts to Critter and earns money; reach grows with time.
Six-second simulated video records and posts.
Refresh restores name, money, rescues, tank, inventory, and Critter posts.
320px and 390px portrait, 844px landscape, and desktop layouts keep panels and controls onscreen.
Virtual D-pad hold moves, release stops; no sticky movement.

limitations: This is preservation coverage for the existing game. It does not verify visual approval or the review page, new art atlas, PNGs or integration demo behavior.

The browser script reports a broad save-restoration message, but it directly compares only hero, money, post count and rescued IDs after reload. It does not establish browser-level tank/inventory equality. The separate domain save test does perform full state-object equality in synthetic storage.
Browser flow covers the girl Hero with accepted loan. Both loan branches are checked by domain tests, not both browser walkthroughs.
Several browser checkpoint labels describe broader behavior than their direct assertions. They are retained verbatim as reported checkpoints, not independent proof of every noun in each label.
Viewport emulation and pointer events in desktop Chrome do not establish physical iPhone/Safari usability.
Existing movement remains continuous and permits normalized diagonals; these tests preserve that baseline and do not establish Emerald cardinal tile timing or M2 approval.
No new migration, NPC occupancy, exhaustive map connectivity, hidden-page timing or full movement/camera/door equivalence test was performed.
No website deployment was performed by this regression run.
